verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents 30 official idiomatic SDKs (13 client-side, 13 server-side, 4 edge), with an edge SDK reference (Cloudflare) and official OpenFeature providers. Community users independently describe building on its client SDKs, streaming connections and SDK defaults. Missing for 10: per-language SDK reference documentation beyond the Cloudflare edge SDK, and no evidence of AI-specific SDK guidance in the pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: 30 idiomatic SDKs 13 client-side, 13 server-side, and 4 edge SDKs.
If you are using Cloudflare SDK version 2.3.0 or later, you can use the Cloudflare SDK by itself.
LaunchDarkly offers official OpenFeature providers for several of our SDKs... You can use these providers in your application in place of a LaunchDarkly SDK.
LaunchDarkly SDKs can pass any context attributes you want to LaunchDarkly, where you can then use those attributes in flag targeting.
